title: cop.trace-ref/v1
description: Canonical COP Trace reference primitive (Issue #61, #63). Identifies or addresses a Trace without requiring COP to own its bytes.

trace_id.description: Canonical trace identity string or URI (e.g. cop:event:<id>, cop:artifact:<hash>, or external URN).

integrity.description: Optional cryptographic digest verifying trace integrity.

locator.description: Resolution locator (URL, path, topic identifier, store ref) distinct from intrinsic content identity.

resolution_hints.description: Optional hints aiding resolution (e.g. topic_id, topic_seq, mime_type, provider).
